name: Sir Isaac Cavendish
original_name: サー・アイザック・キャヴェンディッシュ
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Hobby: Flirting with Women
Special Skill: Shooting, Knife Throwing
Likes: Women, Walks, Hand-Rolled Tobacco, Whisky
Dislikes: Men, Keeping things tidy, Aristocrats
Image Color: Red

The eldest son of a fallen English noble. He had a hard time growing up.
He's an intelligence operative in the army who passes himself off as a struggling writer.
A wild kind of guy.
